title: Shortness of breath
diagnosis: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) or pulmonary edema as potential causes of shortness of breath in an undiagnosed patient
correct_orders: Obtain vital signs, including oxygen saturation and blood pressure
Perform chest X-ray to evaluate lung fields
Order arterial blood gas (ABG) analysis for oxygenation status and acid-base balance
Administer supplemental oxygen as needed to maintain oxygen saturation above 90%
Initiate diuretics if signs of heart failure are present or pulmonary edema is suspected
Consider obtaining echocardiogram to assess cardiac function
Consult Internal Medicine, Pulmonology, and Intensive Care Unit (ICU) as needed based on the patient's condition
should_avoid: Discharging the patient without a clear diagnosis or stabilization
